intro: Wrenix the Wretched is a goblin tinker stationed in the bustling port town of Ratchet. Operating beside his strange gizmotronic apparatus, he offers specialized assistance to those seeking to crack tough locks and plunder secure caches.

p: Found lounging alongside his peculiar machinery in the goblin port of Ratchet, Wrenix the Wretched represents the opportunistic, pragmatic spirit of the Steamwheedle Cartel. Despite his downcast moniker, he possesses specialized knowledge regarding mechanisms, contraptions, and the delicate art of bypass and salvage, making him an invaluable contact for aspiring scoundrels and scouts working the coast.

Positioned right next to Wrenix is his prized gizmotronic apparatus, a humming testament to goblin ingenuity. Wrenix puts this device and his own mechanical expertise to work by supplying specialized tools—such as thieves' tools and lock-picking instruments—to operatives seeking to recover stolen Southsea pirate contraband along the Merchant Coast.
